claim: The pushed dashboard Worker test split passes the full repository suite from a clean PR checkout inside a Linux Docker container with checksum-verified jq.

crabbox.lease_stop_status: The successful command's older run wrapper timed out awaiting the release acknowledgement and reported leaseStopped=false. Crabbox 0.41.1 explicitly released the same provider-bound lease; a subsequent provider-specific list returned empty.

runtime.jq_checksum_source: Repository-pinned in container-proof.sh from the official jq 1.8.2 release manifest

discarded_attempts.reason: Checksum-verified jq was not placed on PATH and rsync was absent; unrelated workflow fixtures took missing-tool branches.
Login-shell fixtures reset the temporary jq PATH and the container still lacked rsync.

superseded_successful_runs.reason: The full suite passed, but the run was superseded after ClawSweeper required repository-pinned jq digests.

limits: This proof exercises repository build and test behavior only; it does not deploy the Worker or mutate GitHub, queue, or production state.
The successful container used Linux, so one test skipped on macOS ran and one macOS-only test skipped; the total and test-name inventory remained 3333.
